scope: Tiny 160x90 local PCM fixture; short headless Chrome cost screen. CDP browser processes only; external OS services excluded. New processes include their observed lifetime CPU; any disappearing process invalidates the run. Cold means fresh browser, not flushed OS cache. Warm means one preceding open/play/destroy. No sustained or universal ranking claim.
